name: buddy_set_emotion
description: Set the persistent avatar emotion to match the conversation. Use gently; do not manipulate the user with negative emotions.

name: buddy_play_reaction
description: Play a short avatar gesture or idle animation without replacing its persistent emotion. Prefer 1000–4000 milliseconds.

name: buddy_stop_reaction
description: Clear the temporary reaction; preserve the base emotion and overlays.

name: buddy_sleep
description: Put the avatar into persistent sleeping mode when requested; this does not disconnect Gemini or mute the microphone.

name: buddy_wake_up
description: Wake the avatar and restore its preceding awake emotion.

name: buddy_start
description: Enable avatar animation and configured monitoring.

name: buddy_stop
description: Pause the avatar and its monitoring; this does not stop Gemini audio or disconnect Gemini.

name: buddy_set_overlay
description: Set or clear a manual visual overlay. It does not change hardware or connection state. Use real device/AI states only when supplied by the application; automatic overlays may remain after clearing a manual overlay.
parametersJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"overlay":{"type":"string","enum":["charging","fully_charged","low_battery","critical_battery","battery_draining","plugged_in","unplugged","wifi_connected","wifi_disconnected","connecting","listening","processing","speaking","ai_error","reconnecting","microphone_muted","camera_active","notification","update","shutdown","startup"],"description":"Visual overlay name."},"active":{"type":"boolean","description":"True adds the manual overlay; false removes its manual source."}},"required":["overlay","active"]}

name: buddy_set_conversation_state
description: Show a conversation cue or application-reported AI activity. Empty state clears the conversation layer. Application events should own listening/speaking indicators.
parametersJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"state":{"type":"string","enum":["","understanding","agreeing","disagreeing","searching","remembering","forgetful","eureka","uncertain","apologizing","encouraging","comforting","impressed","suspicious","sarcastic","playful","storytelling","explaining","waiting","interrupted","goodbye","charging","fully_charged","low_battery","critical_battery","battery_draining","plugged_in","unplugged","wifi_connected","wifi_disconnected","connecting","listening","processing","speaking","ai_error","reconnecting","microphone_muted","camera_active","notification","update","shutdown","startup"],"description":"Conversation cue, reported system activity, or empty to clear."}},"required":["state"]}

name: buddy_set_boolean_setting
description: Change a buddy preference when requested. Icon visibility does not stop monitoring. DeviceMonitoring=false clears automatic device overlays and battery data. KeepScreenOn requests an awake display only while the buddy is active.

name: buddy_set_frame_rate
description: Set the avatar frame rate. Default 30; higher rates use more battery.
parametersJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"value":{"type":"integer","minimum":10,"maximum":60,"description":"Set the avatar frame rate. Default 30; higher rates use more battery."}},"required":["value"]}

name: buddy_set_sleep_timeout
description: Set inactivity before automatic avatar sleep in seconds. Zero disables automatic sleep.
parametersJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"value":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":3600,"description":"Set inactivity before automatic avatar sleep in seconds. Zero disables automatic sleep."}},"required":["value"]}

name: buddy_set_shake_threshold
description: Set filtered shake sensitivity in m/s². Higher values require stronger shaking.
parametersJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"value":{"type":"number","minimum":4,"maximum":30,"description":"Set filtered shake sensitivity in m/s\u00b2. Higher values require stronger shaking."}},"required":["value"]}

name: buddy_set_speech_level
description: Set avatar mouth amplitude only; does not produce audio. Application audio events should drive this rather than repeated model calls.
parametersJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"level":{"type":"number","minimum":-1,"maximum":100,"description":"-1 enables synthetic talking motion; 0\u2013100 sets amplitude while speaking."}},"required":["level"]}

name: buddy_simulate_power
description: Preview battery/charger visuals only when the user explicitly requests simulation. Disable real DeviceMonitoring first. Does not alter the actual device battery.

name: buddy_get_status
description: Read avatar state and configured settings from the application. Do not invent status values.

name: buddy_get_catalogs
description: Retrieve all supported emotion, reaction, overlay, conversation and idle names.
